application-completeness.name: Application Completeness
application-completeness.description: Index the application PDFs, mark each required form present or missing on a CSV, and write the pack.

denied-file-routing.name: Denied File Routing
denied-file-routing.description: Read their screening-status export and route rows by their code only — pending, complete, or the word they used.

hours-and-tours.name: Hours And Tours
hours-and-tours.description: Read the hours or holiday PDF they dropped and the showing calendar, then list tours that fit posted hours and flag any booked outside those hours.

lease-packet.name: Lease Packet
lease-packet.description: Index the lease-packet folder, tick addenda against their checklist, and write the pack.

make-ready-vs-move-in.name: Make Ready Vs Move In
make-ready-vs-move-in.description: Read make-ready status and lease-start dates, then flag units whose commence date is earlier than ready.

showing-day.name: Showing Day
showing-day.description: Read the showing calendar and the availability sheet, then list today's tours with unit or floorplan as booked.

specials-from-file.name: Specials From File
specials-from-file.description: Read the dated specials sheet and the availability export, then list which open floorplans still match a live offer.

traffic-log.name: Traffic Log
traffic-log.description: Pull guest cards, tally source labels as written, and write a traffic pack.

waitlist.name: Waitlist
waitlist.description: Read their waitlist CSV in the existing order and write the pack.
